question: One wall of the ______ stadium is dedicated to cricketer Rahul Dravid.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Chinnaswamy.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• One wall of the **Chinnaswamy stadium **is dedicated to cricketer **Rahul Dravid.**
 
• Rahul Dravid is one of the greatest cricketers that India has produced.
 
• He is famously known as** Mr Dependable** for being a steady and reliable batsman.
 
• He is also known as **The Great Wall or The Wall.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

 
• To celebrate his 10,000 Test runs, Karnataka State Cricket Association built a wall with **10,000 bricks in the M Chinnaswamy stadium **in **Bengaluru, Karnataka.**
 
• It has a metal statue with the inscription of Rahul Dravid playing his trademark cover-drive move.
 
• The words** “Commitment, Consistency, Class”** are also seen there.
 
• The wall is** 27 feet high and 15 feet wide.**
 
• This wall was inaugurated by another cricketing legend, **Sachin Tendulkar.**
